'''Tarroco Island''' (Japanese: '''バンペイユ島''' ''Banpeiyu Island'') is one of the [[Orange Islands]]. 

A small settlement, including several houses and a [[Pokémon Center]], is located on a cliff overlooking the ocean. An [[Officer Jenny]] patrols the streets of Tarroco Island.

Because the island is a 'no-capture zone', it is a very common place for pirates to appear and [[Pokémon hunter|poach]] the Pokémon on the island. When {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived on Tarroco in ''[[EP113|Viva Las Lapras]]'' they learned [[Captain Crook]] and his crew were targeting a migrating school of {{OBP|Lapras|herd}} nearby. [[Ash's Lapras]], who had become stranded, recognized these Lapras as its own school. It and the group helped defeat Captain Crook before leaving Ash's team to return to its family.

==Trivia==
* Its English name refers to the tarocco ({{wp|blood orange}}), while its Japanese, ''Banpeiyu'', name is another term for the {{wp|pomelo}}, a large citrus fruit whose appearance is similar to a grapefruit.
